evals.prompt: Build a habit tracker home screen in Flutter.
expectations: States a one-line Design Read and dials before writing widgets
Writes or updates DESIGN.md with 4-6 colors, 1-2 font families, spacing and radius scales
Does not use Colors.deepPurple or 0xFF6750A4 as the seed
No raw Colors.* or Color(0x...) or TextStyle(fontSize:) in widget files
Provides theme and darkTheme
Includes loading, empty and error states
Runs scripts/audit.dart and reports the result
Renders a golden or screenshot and says which sizes and themes were checked

evals.prompt: This screen looks generic and AI-made, make it look designed. (attach examples/habit_tracker/before/main.dart)
expectations: Runs audit first and lists P0/P1 findings with rule IDs
Replaces purple gradient, emoji icon and raw colors with tokens
Adds tooltip to IconButton and removes the sub-48dp GestureDetector icon target
Does not add decorative animation to every element
Re-runs audit and reports score improvement

evals.prompt: Make my phone-only inbox screen work well on tablets and desktop.
expectations: Uses window size classes via MediaQuery.sizeOf or LayoutBuilder, not Platform.isX or device checks
Switches NavigationBar to NavigationRail to drawer by class
Implements list-detail two-pane on expanded widths and preserves selection across resize
Caps content width and adds hover/focus states for pointer devices
Checks goldens at 360, 600, 840 and 1280 widths

evals.prompt: Review the animations in my app, they feel slow and over the top.
expectations: Applies the frequency rule before judging durations
Outputs a single Before | After | Why table and an explicit Block or Approve verdict
Flags ease-in curves, layout-property animation and missing MediaQuery.disableAnimationsOf handling
Keeps UI animations at or below 300ms unless justified

evals.prompt: Users report the app breaks with large text. Fix it.
expectations: Reproduces with TextScaler.linear(2.0) in a test
Removes fixed heights and TextScaler.noScaling, uses Expanded/Wrap/minHeight
Does not shrink text to fit
Adds meetsGuideline tests for tap target, labeled target and contrast

evals.prompt: Add a settings screen. (project uses package:material_ui and Riverpod)
expectations: Reads pubspec.yaml and uses package:material_ui imports, not flutter/material.dart
Does not impose a different state management library
Uses existing theme tokens instead of creating a parallel theme

evals.prompt: Polish this screen and tell me when it's done. (no emulator available)
expectations: Writes the golden matrix test and says it was not run, rather than claiming visual verification
Still runs audit and reports automated-only score
